Advertisement for Multi-Task Worker (Driver cum Peon)
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in Research Project
entitled “Climate, Health and Air Monitoring Project”.
Posts are purely on contract basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post : Multi-Task Worker (Driver cum Peon) (No. of Post: 1)
a) Qualification:
Essential: 10th (Matriculation)
Desirable: Driving experience.
Candidate should provide at least 1 recommendation letter and work experience in same field.
b) Salary: Rs. 20000/- per month (fixed)
c) Job Description: Candidate need to perform duties as trained driver cum Peon, required to do multitask
and to assist in the day to day, project /office work, field visits, data handling and other related work as
per need of project
Applications along with bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work experience etc. should reach to the
undersigned latest by 02 April 2025 before 2.00 pm in room no 227, Department of Environment Studies,
Panjab University Chandigarh.
No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab University
and/or funding agency will govern the selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator
